scope: Reconstructed C only. Real links to all sixteen segment/glue modules, the nine timeline families and their real dependencies (Json_*, toColor, readCurve, setError/ReportSpineError/Json_dispose, spSkeletonData_create/dispose and every record disposer, findBone/findSlotIndex/findSkin, spSkin_*, spAttachmentLoader_*, the five attachment constructors, region offset / mesh UV bodies, _readVertices, _malloc/_calloc/_free). Errors the segment modules report as codes are closed here with dispose->setError->NULL; the out-of-window 0x28e7f4 unknown-attachment tail is closed here too. Synthetic boundaries: Json_create/Json_getError, the four local record creators, spSkeletonData_findSlot (0x28b070), the animation and timeline creators/setters, the four synthetic find* scans, the attachment loader record, the fixture heap and libc. The root slot [sp,#0x24] is carried by readSkeletonData_rootSlot because the entry module cannot return it. Not an original-equivalence claim.
